"Sun = Mercury/Neptune": "Imaginative and creative thinking and writing. The ability to become inspired. Instinctive decision making. Receptive and perceptive. Compassionate. Idealistic objectives. Easily influenced. Gullibility. Secretive. Evasive. Tendency to lack clarity of thought. Misunderstandings and misconceptions. Confusion and disorientation. Nervous exhaustion. Receptivity for thoughts, author.

You are very intuitive and imaginative. While others often need scientific proof, you very often prefer to trust your intuition. You also have a good appreciation for poetry and literature. Any subject that is taught in a dry, formal, unimaginative manner bores you, and, as an adult, you may consider yourself very inept in various subject areas only because they were presented to you in a very dry manner when you were young. Sometimes your imagination and your inclination to create fantasies or fictional stories can make it difficult for you to concentrate on studies, disinclining you to throw yourself wholeheartedly into academics.

There is the capacity to intuitively interpret what others experience. Many gifted artists and musicians have this, as well as a wonderful sense of imagination along with a great appreciation of the creative arts. This also relates to using the spoken word to elicit illusion. On the negative side, it can be used to be deceitful. On the positive side of this, there is the ability to identify with one's spiritual pursuits and be able to communicate that to others through the spoken and written word.

Energizes psychic reasoning and helps you evaluate hunches as a means for finding answers to problems or questions; feelings of fullness and completion as dreams materialize; effective creative mental visualization.
